name: com.apex6.robot
description: Runtime control kit for the exported APEX-6 six-axis industrial robot. Drives the model's six joint pivots (forward kinematics), a parallel-jaw gripper, pose presets, an optional CCD IK, an in-game IMGUI control panel, and cable routing that makes the flexible hoses follow the arm. Ships no geometry of its own: load the provided model and add Apex6Controller to its root.
